title: STS2 AI Agent
changeNote: v0.12.3 (re-cut again, same version number): fix a Continue button that stayed grey while the AI Teammate tab was open - once the launch dialog closed the button kept waiting for you to leave the tab and come back, even though the action was ready. Kept from the previous build: Continue the saved co-op run and Disable automatic character pick on the AI Teammate tab, and an Invite button that takes the same route as the API, so with no verified model it still invites and the teammate waits to be taken over instead of refusing the click. The rest of this build is diagnostics: paths that used to fail silently now say so in the log, so a stuck action can be told apart from an action that had nothing to do.
